decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo inkjet printer sits close to the firm's core inkjet and ink expertise, so its in-house R&D can interpret early results and refine the product.
The numbering software module extends the firm's existing software portfolio for variable-data printing and fits its digitalization and serialization strategy, so it is easy to absorb and improve.
An inkjet coder for non-absorbent surfaces builds directly on the firm's established coding technology and ink know-how, giving it strong absorptive capacity to develop it further.
